objective: total delay = sum over trains of finish_time[train] - (sum of duration over the resources left on its route)

resource.description: Resource id; even ids are stations, odd ids are the single tracks between them
resource.label: resource

duration.description: Least time a train occupies the resource (running time on a track, dwell time at a station)
duration.label: minimum time on the resource

capacity.description: Trains that may occupy the resource at the same time
capacity.label: train capacity

resources.description: Dash-separated resource ids in travel order
resources.label: resources in travel order

start.description: Resource on its route where the train is now; it still has to cover the rest of the route
start.label: current position

ready_time.description: Time at which the train enters its current resource (0 = now); a later time is an extra delay
ready_time.label: ready time

decision_variables.entry_time[train, resource]: minutes, when the train starts to occupy the resource
decision_variables.finish_time[train]: minutes, when the train leaves its last resource
decision_variables.goes_first[resource, train, other_train]: binary, 1 if the train has moved on before the other train enters the resource
decision_variables.meet[resource, train, other_train]: binary, 1 if the two trains may occupy the resource at the same time (fixed to 0 on capacity-1 resources)

constraints.run[train, resource]: entry_time of the next resource >= entry_time[train, resource] + duration
constraints.finish[train]: finish_time == entry_time of the last resource + its duration
constraints.order[resource, train, other_train]: big-M: other train enters after this train has moved on, if goes_first
constraints.capacity[resource, trains]: for each set of capacity+1 visiting trains: sum of their meet pairs <= C(capacity+1, 2) - 1

goes_first.label: trains clearing a resource before another train enters it

meet.label: train pairs sharing a resource at the same time
